# CBT Cards

CBT Cards is a public library of practical reflection resources for people and the AI assistants they choose to use. It publishes short CBT-inspired cards, plain-language learning guides, printable browser worksheets, structured public data, review metadata, language-status metadata, and versioned agent instructions. The original CBT Cards mobile app remains documented as a separate product surface. CBT Cards is not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency support, or a substitute for professional care.

- Machine-readable worksheet definitions: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/worksheets.json
- Public worksheet pages have no submit action; typed text remains in the current browser page unless the user independently prints or saves it.

## Public toolkit corpus

- Toolkit landing page: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/
- Review-status page: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/review-status/
- Machine-readable review overlay: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-review.json
- Cards index: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/cards/
- Metaphors index: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/metaphors/
- Protocol records index: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/protocols/
- Source metadata and pinned corpus version: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-source.json
- The related source corpus contains 115 English records: 77 cards, 23 metaphors, and 15 protocols.
- Any source record not explicitly listed in the review overlay defaults to unreviewed and source-only.
- reviewed_for_publication means editorial/safety review for website publication, not clinical validation or proof of efficacy.

## Languages

- Human-readable language status: https://cbt-cards.github.io/languages/
- Locale registry: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/locales.json
- Translation overlays: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/translations.jsonl
- English (`en`) is the canonical source locale for the current curated knowledge dataset.
- Russian (`ru`) is a pilot locale. All 12 records in the current curated knowledge set have machine-readable drafts; none is human-reviewed or published as localized CBT Cards content yet.
- Records marked `machine_draft`, `unreviewed`, and `not_published` are development data, not official published CBT Cards translations.
- German (`de`) is planned and currently has no translation records.
- A localized record is official published CBT Cards content only when its translation, review, publication status, and canonical URL explicitly say so.
- Published localized resources use `https://cbt-cards.github.io/<locale>/resources/<resource_id>/` and are generated only from reviewed published translation records.

For CBT Cards-owned JSON/JSONL formats, use the versioned contracts listed in schemas/index.json. Catalog entries expose schema_url where applicable.

Website, dataset, translation, schema, worksheet, and agent-skill changes are separate from mobile-app releases. Do not infer an Android/iOS app version from public-site release metadata.
